run.scope: narrow retest after the frontend fix; the old poisoned history was not cleared, and no source files were edited by the tester

labels.LIVE_MODEL: not used in this retest (the one live coach call happened in the original run)
labels.MOCK: page.route responses to /api/career/ai-assist; each MOCK response was checked against the generated zod contract
labels.UI: browser interaction, storage structure reads (no text values), download file inspection, viewport measurement

run.caveat: Device-local AI state (answers, voice samples, history) is in the browser profile. The notebook reset started a new profile, so pre-reset saved answers are not present in this profile. Versions are server-side and intact.
